name: presidents-pdb-bin-ladin.pdf
description: This document is a two-page fragmentary intelligence summary on Bin Laden's intent to strike the United States, covering 1997–1998 plots and embassy bombings, followed by an August 6, 2001 "For the President Only" note on suspicious FBI activity and about 70 full field investigations.

metadata.title: Bin Ladin Determined To Strike in US
